name: Sensei no Goshujin-sama
source:
Science teacher Shinami-sensei had failed with his investments. As a result, all of the girls he was dating cut ties with him.

Around the same time, he found out his female student Yusa's secret. However, she also knew of his "shortcomings" and ended up getting the upper hand. Threatening Shinami-sensei, Yusa forces him to live with her.

As he gets treated like a plaything by his bespectacled, braided and plain student, Yusa, Shinami-sensei gradually learns more about her "true" self...

Shinami-sensei also changes a little- as a person, as a teacher and as an adult.

[Mostly based on the translation of DL Site's plot summary]
No longer available.
translation:
科学老师西波老师的投资失败了。结果，所有与他约会的女孩都与他断绝了关系。

大约在同一时间，他发现了女学生游纱的秘密。不过，她也知道他的“缺点”，最终占了上风。游佐威胁西波老师，强迫他和自己住在一起。

当他被戴着眼镜、扎着辫子、相貌平平的学生游佐当作玩物对待时，西波老师逐渐了解了更多关于她“真实”的自我……

西波老师也发生了一些变化——作为一个人，作为一个老师，作为一个成年人。

【大部分是根据DL Site的剧情概要翻译的】不再可用。
